KaTeX math rendering for the docked Markdown modal (Dan, 2026): self-registering bootstrap that installs a SMALL CUSTOM marked extension (defined in THIS file -- the vendored stock marked-katex-extension was tried first, then REPLACED after a live false-positive report) onto the global marked instance at content-script load, so inline $...$ and display $$...$$ in composer strings render as math at the ONE existing choke point (composedMarkdownToHtml -> marked.parse) with ZERO call-site / server / spec / wire changes. GRAMMAR (pandoc-flavored, v2): opening $ must NOT be followed by whitespace; the content may NOT contain '$' or a newline; the content may NOT end in whitespace; the closing $ must NOT be followed by a digit (the currency guard: 'costs $5 and $10' stays plain text). The '$'-free content rule makes the reported failure IMPOSSIBLE BY CONSTRUCTION: the stock grammar REJECTED legitimate math immediately followed by ')' (its trailing lookahead admitted only [ws ?!.,:] or end, so '$0.50$)' failed), and because stock content COULD span a '$', the orphaned '$' then ran away to a distant later '$' and rendered a whole prose paragraph as red broken TeX. A match here can never cross a '$', so a misfire is bounded to one short span, never a paragraph. Also fixed vs stock: math immediately followed by ')' ';' ']' etc. now RENDERS, including parenthesized math like '($p < 0.05$)' (the stock start() required the opening '$' at start-or-after-space and missed that too). Broken TeX still degrades to red source (throwOnError:false) with a try/catch escaped-raw fallback. Block display math is '$$' on its own lines ('$$\n...\n$$', multi-line content allowed); a single-line '$$x$$' renders as inline displayMode. Load order is pinned in manifest.json: marked.min.js -> katex/katex.min.js -> THIS file -> glimpse-cache-client.js; KaTeX css + fonts are injected via the manifest (katex/katex.min.css + katex-overrides.css; fonts via web_accessible_resources). No-ops with a console.warn if marked/katex are absent, so a vendoring slip degrades to the old plain render, never a broken dock.

KaTeX math rendering for the docked Markdown modal (Dan, 2026): self-registering bootstrap that installs a SMALL CUSTOM marked extension (defined in THIS file -- the vendored stock marked-katex-extension was tried first, then REPLACED after a live false-positive report) onto the global marked instance at content-script load, so inline $...$ and display $$...$$ in composer strings render as math at the ONE existing choke point (composedMarkdownToHtml -> marked.parse) with ZERO call-site / server / spec / wire changes. GRAMMAR (pandoc-flavored, v2): opening $ must NOT be followed by whitespace; the content may NOT contain '$' or a newline; the content may NOT end in whitespace; the closing $ must NOT be followed by a digit (the currency guard: 'costs $5 and $10' stays plain text). The '$'-free content rule makes the reported failure IMPOSSIBLE BY CONSTRUCTION: the stock grammar REJECTED legitimate math immediately followed by ')' (its trailing lookahead admitted only [ws ?!.,:] or end, so '$0.50$)' failed), and because stock content COULD span a '$', the orphaned '$' then ran away to a distant later '$' and rendered a whole prose paragraph as red broken TeX. A match here can never cross a '$', so a misfire is bounded to one short span, never a paragraph. Also fixed vs stock: math immediately followed by ')' ';' ']' etc. now RENDERS, including parenthesized math like '($p < 0.05$)' (the stock start() required the opening '$' at start-or-after-space and missed that too). Broken TeX still degrades to red source (throwOnError:false) with a try/catch escaped-raw fallback. Block display math is '$$' on its own lines ('$$\n...\n$$', multi-line content allowed); a single-line '$$x$$' renders as inline displayMode. Load order is pinned in manifest.json: marked.min.js -> katex/katex.min.js -> THIS file -> glimpse-cache-client.js; KaTeX css + fonts are injected via the manifest (katex/katex.min.css + katex-overrides.css; fonts via web_accessible_resources). No-ops with a console.warn if marked/katex are absent, so a vendoring slip degrades to the old plain render, never a broken dock.
